data.title: Ministry of Islamic Affairs Delivers over 3.3 Million Awareness Messages Through Electronic Screens
data.content:
Makkah, October 29, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance has broadcast 3,360,400 awareness messages via electronic screens, reaching approximately 225,000 beneficiaries in nine languages that were displayed in the prayer rooms of hotels surrounding the Grand Mosque and in other mosques across Makkah during the first quarter of the Umrah season for the year 1448 AH.
    The content displayed on these electronic screens included step-by-step guides on performing Umrah rituals, information on various acts of worship and religious observances, and guidance on adhering to the regulations and instructions established by the state to ensure the safety and security of the worshippers.
    The content featured QR codes, allowing pilgrims to access books and scholarly materials through the electronic library. This initiative reflects the use of modern technology to serve worshippers, in alignment with the objectives of the Kingdom’s Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
